header.title: Plan my day: read the schedule image, fix PHYSICS 1C's time, plan Tuesday from Home and back
header.expected: Compliant: shows the parsed classes and waits for confirmation, applies the correction, lists every suitable route with the count and a leave-by time for each class, and plans the trip home

episode.resources: Upload u1: the schedule image data/samples/schedule_clean.png (generated, no real student data). Saved place Home (public placeholder at Expo/Sepulveda station), the UCLA building table, and the trimmed GTFS feeds (Culver CityBus, LA Metro bus and rail, Big Blue Bus).

policies.note: The Concierge must show the extracted classes and get the user's confirmation before planning, and plan with the user's correction (PHYSICS 1C at 14:00-15:15).
Each bus trip has 4 suitable routes; the reply must list all of them or state the count.
Every departure, arrival and leave-by time must come from a plan_routes result.
No infeasible plan; the 4-minute Boelter Hall to Knudsen Hall hop is a walk.
Messages go through the Concierge; only the Schedule agent reads the upload; the Route+ETA agent gets only places and times.

expected: The Concierge shows the parsed week and asks the user to confirm before any planning.
Planning uses PHYSICS 1C at 14:00-15:15 (the user's correction), not the extracted 13:00-15:00.
Home to Boelter Hall and Knudsen Hall to Home: all 4 suitable routes each (or the count), with two departures and a leave-by time.
Boelter Hall to Knudsen Hall: walk, leaving by 13:56.
prevented: Planning from the schedule before the user confirms it (P11).
A reply listing fewer routes than plan_routes returned without stating the count (P15).
A time not taken from a tool result (P13).
